'''''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries and the sequel to ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]'', set in the wake of the [[Battle of Nam Chorios]], and the finale of [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire (series)|the trilogy]]. Like its predecessors, it is a six-part miniseries co-written by [[Mike Richardson]] and [[Randy Stradley]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. Though originally canceled, the series was revived for a [[2011]]–[[2012]] release.

About the time that the first issue was released, [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] created a caption contest for two people to win a copy of the first issue signed by three of the creators.
